desc:
GUSHING WITH YUMMINESS: These gummy snacks are a sweet and sour pairing of Watermelon and Sour Apple flavor - two mouthwatering tastes in one pouch; Bite into Gushers and the juicy center bursts with yummy liquid

VITAMIN C: The fruity flavored, chewy snacks are a good source of vitamin C and made without gelatin

GLUTEN FREE: Gushers gummy snacks are gluten free and a treat your whole family can enjoy

ON THE GO SNACKS: Portable pouches are ideal for the pantry, school lunch box, team snacks, kids parties, and more

CONTAINS: One 4.8 oz box of Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks; 6 pouches total
features:
Key Features:

Dual Flavor Explosion

Each pouch combines juicy watermelon and sour apple flavors, with a liquid-filled center that "gushes" when you bite.

Allergen-Friendly

Made without gluten or gelatin, and free from major allergens.

Vitamin C Boost

Each serving delivers about 10% of the recommended daily Vitamin C.

Portable Single-Serve Pouches

Comes in 20 resealable pouches—ideal for lunch boxes, outings, or snacks on the go.

Benefits:

Fun & Flavorful Experience

The burst of juicy liquid makes it a playful treat for kids and adults alike.

Convenient Snacking

Portable, mess-free, and easy to pack—great for school, travel, or after-school snacks.

Health-Conscious Design

With no gluten or gelatin and added Vitamin C, it's a more thoughtful choice than candy.

Sweet & Tangy Boost

Combines sweet and sour tastes in every bite—an exciting snack mix.
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Modified Corn Starch, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Palm Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Cottonseed Oil, Citric Acid, Glycerin, White Grape Juice Concentrate, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Potassium Citrate, Natural Flavor, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Agar-Agar, Xanthan Gum, Color (red 40, yellow 5, blue 1).
